handoff: Review #5 (after the #163 merge): changes requested, 3 blocking doc findings left by the merge resolution. F1: RULES.md W2 lists stalled as a step limit again (D17). F2: docs/limitations.md still describes capability gating and says agent configs replace the built-in entry (B52, B36, B14). F3: the generated Reference config table gives provider a fixed default gh and base_branch null, though both are derived (B22, B23, B54). Minor: (B34) in tick help, exit 6 missing from reference intro, doctor comment, team/repo naming. Unit 1103/0, typecheck clean, generated reference in sync.

findings.title: W2 lists `stalled` as a step limit again
findings.detail:
The W2 `agent` row reads 'limits (`deadline`, `nudges`, `retries`, `stalled`)'. origin/main had the three step limits; the merge (0a37a5fb1) took the old PRD wording. Spec D17: '`stalled` is a workflow limit only … never on a step; steps keep `deadline`, `nudges`, `retries`'. The step schema (packages/schema/src/workflow.ts) refuses `stalled` on a step (B11/B26), so the rule now contradicts the code and W2a.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Restore '(`deadline`, `nudges`, `retries`)' in the W2 agent row; optionally point at the workflow `defaults:` for `stalled`.

findings.title: limitations.md describes removed capability gating and replace-semantics for agent entries
findings.detail:
Line 65: 'Capability gating stops a QA agent from claiming what it cannot check, not from lying.' Capabilities and the capability check are removed (B36, QV5a). Line 60: 'Every live run used configs that replace it' (the auto permission mode default): under B14 an agents.claude entry merges field by field and only `args` replaces. B52: 'describe only the new keys and files'. The S5 lint matches only `capabilities: [`, so the prose passes.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Reword both lines (e.g. drop the capability sentence; say live runs set `args`, which replaces the list). Consider extending the lint to 'capability gating'/'capability check'.

findings.title: Reference Config keys table shows fixed defaults for derived `provider` and `base_branch`
findings.detail:
docs/reference.md's generated table says `provider` built-in default `"gh"` and `base_branch` `null`. Spec: B22 'provider detected from the remote URL when unset' (glab for a gitlab remote), B54 refuses an unknown host, B23 'base_branch to default to the remote's default branch'. A reader of Reference concludes a GitLab repo needs `provider: glab`. packages/cli/test/unit/reference.test.ts:43-44 pins these values.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Render derived keys as 'derived: remote URL' / 'derived: remote default branch' (e.g. a small map of derived keys in reference.ts, or read norn config's derived reasons) and update the test to expect that.

findings.title: Spec id `(B34)` in user-facing option help
findings.detail:
optionHelp '--interval': '… claim timing (B34)' is rendered raw into docs/reference.md:401 and `norn help tick`; plainSummary strips ids only from summaries (gh-162: spec ids mean nothing to a reader).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move B34 to a code comment.

findings.title: Reference intro lists exit codes without `config` (6)
findings.detail:
'The exit code says why: refused (3) … busy (5)' omits the config exit code B7/D3 add; the generated table below does list it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add '`config` (6) when a config file is wrong'.

findings.title: doctor header comment names `default_mode` and a configured runner
findings.detail:
' with `default_mode: manual` a failing runner is a warning' and 'configured runner'; the runner is derived (B29) and mode is `mode`.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Say 'in manual mode' and 'the detected runner'.

findings.title: Two names for the team file
findings.detail:
Reference's File column says `team` (FILE_LABEL repo: 'team'); `norn config` sources and config set/unset summaries say `repo` ('user, local or repo config file'). ConfigLayerName = ConfigFileKind alias (store config.ts:161) adds a third name.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Pick one word in user-facing text, or say 'team (repo)' once.

findings.title: URL type detected by schema description text
findings.detail:
`s.description === "http or https URL"`: editing the Url description silently turns the column into 'string'. reference.test.ts:27-33 also re-walks the schema the way configRows does.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Match on Url's pattern/format, as Duration.pattern is.
